name: Ocean Friends 2
description: Sixteen more sea friends: a walrus, a narwhal, a manatee, a lobster, a puffin, a hermit crab, an angelfish, a nautilus, a sunfish, a little submarine, a beluga, an orca, a seagull with a sandcastle, a shrimp, a flying fish and a pelican.
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly sea subject, centered, filling most of the page. Around it only a few separate closed shapes: big round bubbles, a closed seaweed leaf, a closed rock. No open lines at all: no water lines, no wave strokes, no ground lines, no sand ripples, no loose squiggles. The subject itself is split into about 16 large closed areas to color (body, belly, fins, tail, stripes or patches). Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Nothing scary, no teeth, no sharp spikes. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.

pages.name: Walrus Wave
pages.subject: a chubby smiling walrus with two short rounded tusks and big flippers, lying on an ice floe beside one big wave

pages.name: Narwhal Swirl
pages.subject: a round happy narwhal with a short rounded striped horn, a separate belly and a big tail, with three big bubbles

pages.name: Lobster Hello
pages.subject: a smiling lobster with two big rounded claws raised to wave, a tail of wide segments and four short legs, on sand

pages.name: Puffin Rock

pages.name: Hermit Crab Home

pages.name: Angelfish Reef
pages.subject: an angelfish with tall top and bottom fins and three wide stripes, swimming past two chunky coral branches

pages.name: Nautilus Spiral
pages.subject: a nautilus with a big round spiral shell of wide chambers, a small face and a few short rounded tentacles

pages.name: Sunfish Drift
pages.subject: a big round ocean sunfish with a tall top fin and a tall bottom fin, and a ring of big bubbles around it

pages.name: Submarine Peek
pages.subject: a round little submarine with three big round windows, a periscope and a propeller, with a small fish looking in

pages.name: Beluga Bubbles
pages.subject: a smiling beluga whale with a round forehead, two flippers and a tail, blowing three big bubble rings

pages.name: Orca Bubbles
pages.subject: a friendly orca whale seen from the side, swimming left, clearly whale-shaped with a long rounded body, a tall curved back fin, two side flippers and a big two-lobed tail. Its mouth is closed with no teeth. Big separate closed patches: an oval patch behind the eye, a long belly patch, and a saddle patch behind the back fin. Three big round bubbles above it. The body is not filled black, only outlined

pages.name: Shrimp Curl
pages.subject: a big chubby curled shrimp filling most of the page, with a round head, a body of five very wide segments, a wide fan tail of three parts, four short rounded legs and two thick curly antennae, beside two big round bubbles

pages.name: Flying Fish

pages.name: Pelican Post
